registered.meaning: The detector is in default_sensors() and declares its debt kinds and routines.

executable.meaning: The detector has focused fixture tests listed under proof that exercise its scan.

actively-observed.meaning: A specific receipt lists the detector under coverageKnown; never claimed by this catalog.

partially-covered.meaning: The routine has at least one detector but declared remainingGaps the detectors cannot see. A receipt also adds it live to a detector it lists under partialCoverage: the scan completed but skipped subjects, so nothing the detector owns was swept.

unknown-unavailable.meaning: A receipt lists the detector under coverageUnknown or notEvaluated, or does not list it at all. Never healthy.

eligible-auto-remediation.meaning: A debt kind of the detector has a Class A repair executor in POLICY.yaml.

human-gated.meaning: A debt kind of the detector is Class C and only a founder decision disposes of it.

routines.title: Dead-Code Gardener
routines.predicate: Evidence identifies a stale path and proves no supported consumer remains.
remainingGaps: Findings are candidates: deletion still requires usage and external-contract evidence a static scan cannot see (docs, workflows, supported consumers).

routines.title: Architecture and Abstraction Doctor
routines.predicate: Observed coupling, duplication, or repeated defect justifies a bounded abstraction change.
remainingGaps: Cycles and duplication are structural signals only; abstraction quality and ownership remain judgment work.

routines.title: Error, Diagnostics, and Incident Learner
routines.predicate: A registered sensor failure becomes explicit coverage-unknown debt rather than a healthy observation.
remainingGaps: Incident learning (post-incident reproduction and diagnostics review) has no detector; only swallowed exceptions and sensor coverage failures are observed.

routines.title: Test Portfolio Gardener
routines.predicate: A behavior change or repeated regression reveals a missing, redundant, or mis-tiered test contract.
remainingGaps: Weak assertions and redundant coverage are not measured; only shadowed tests, unregistered markers and empty modules are.

routines.title: Flake and Isolation Hunter
routines.predicate: Observed nondeterminism is reproduced under controlled conditions and classified by source.
remainingGaps: Flake history depends on a driver-supplied test-history input; without it the sensor is not evaluated, never healthy.

routines.title: CLI and Runtime Contract Steward
routines.predicate: The CLI contract sensor detects declared command/contract drift and has a policy-backed Class B dispatch route.
remainingGaps: Runtime contract checks beyond the static command surface (exit codes, output formats) are not observed.

routines.title: Mutation, Authorization, and Abuse-Boundary Examiner
routines.predicate: Registry integrity and frozen-record checks expose selected mutation-boundary violations.
remainingGaps: Authorization behaviour is checked statically; abuse paths needing runtime exercise remain manual.

routines.title: Schema Evolution Steward
routines.predicate: The bundled schema mirror is compared against its canonical source and a bounded Class A repair executor is registered.
remainingGaps: Schema compatibility across versions (breaking-change detection) is not observed; only validity and mirror parity are.

routines.title: Evidence and Trust Reconciler
routines.predicate: Registered evidence, trust, benchmark, and taxonomy sensors identify selected drift; trust calibration has a proposal-only route.
remainingGaps: Hooks 1922, 1445 and 2063 remain unknown/not-evaluated until fresh independent verification.
Trust calibration findings are report-only until the Star Bar is applied in the sensor; calibration needs founder approval.

routines.title: Timeline Causality Keeper
routines.predicate: Frozen skill integrity provides a limited frozen-state check, not a lifecycle event-chain audit.
remainingGaps: Out-of-order events are detected; their correction is a curated, human-gated timeline decision (see steward-timeline-order-1699).

routines.title: Registry Structure and Installability Examiner
routines.predicate: Registry integrity, unresolved generic mapping, and upstream drift have narrow sensor coverage.
remainingGaps: Installability against live upstream repositories is not probed (no network).

routines.title: Artifact, Branch, and Repository Hygiene Sentinel
routines.predicate: Repository hygiene, mirror parity, and selected generated projection drift are mapped to existing sensors and policy bindings.
remainingGaps: Stale remote branches and large-artifact growth are not observed.

routines.title: CI Architecture and Efficiency Steward
routines.predicate: A measured CI failure or runtime pattern supports a bounded workflow responsibility or efficiency change.
remainingGaps: CI health depends on a driver-supplied run history; without it ci-health is not evaluated, never healthy.
CI cost and cache efficiency are not measured.

routines.title: Release and Supply-Chain Examiner
routines.predicate: Upstream watcher can identify a narrow local metadata/release-manifest drift predicate.
remainingGaps: Advisories depend on a driver-supplied pip-audit run; without it dependency-advisory is not evaluated.
Release artifact provenance (wheel contents, signatures) is not observed.

routines.title: Frontend Quality and Resilience Steward
routines.predicate: Selected generated frontend projections and hand-authored page source are checked statically; a driver-supplied headless-browser render adds same-origin load failures, page errors and mobile overflow.
remainingGaps: Accessibility and visual correctness are not observed: the render input records load, script-error and overflow facts only, so no accessibility or visual assurance is claimed; frontend fixes are human-gated by CLAUDE.md.
The browser render needs a driver (Chromium via scripts/steward_collect_browser_render.js); without a fresh input the detector is not evaluated, never healthy.
Browser findings come from a local static server with external requests aborted, so they may differ from the deployed site.

routines.title: Browser, Privacy, and External Trust Auditor
routines.predicate: A change with an external data flow or browser sink receives an explicit security/privacy review.
remainingGaps: Third-party script and privacy-policy review remain manual; sinks are lexical findings.

routines.title: Knowledge, Nomenclature, and Agent-Surface Editor
routines.predicate: Knowledge contradictions, agent-skill mirror parity, and taxonomy script drift have limited coverage.
remainingGaps: Banned-vocabulary and nomenclature checks run in their own CI gates, not as Steward detectors.

routines.title: GitHub Issue Hygiene
routines.predicate: Upstream candidate and bot-report issues that the registry proves preserved are closed only through forge.close_issue under an enabled rule; suite batches await a Class B disposition proposal; founder questions await a ruling.
remainingGaps: Human-authored issues outside the upstream and gh-aw bot families are not reconciled; hygiene never closes or classifies them.
Bot families other than gh-aw are reported as untracked; their reports are not dispositioned.
Pull-request linking uses merged-pull-request evidence from the census only; a referenced or open pull request is never closure proof.
Closure is limited to rules A1 to A5 as enabled in POLICY; any item outside them is batch review or a founder question.
